'''2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Clayton Atkin DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Clayton Atkin]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
